path_policy.path_expansion: Expand <temporary-root> and <lane-id> to fresh absolute per-lane roots before launch; do not resolve relative to this fixture directory.

path_encoding.canonical_form: Use absolute paths after token expansion; forward slashes are the portable descriptor form.
path_encoding.windows_form: A Windows runner may convert separators only after expansion and must Java-properties-escape each backslash as \\ when writing a .properties value; shell quoting is not path escaping.

required: Set JMETER_LANGUAGE/user.language/user.region before the -q property file; late language properties do not change initLocale.
Set java.util.prefs.userRoot before JVM startup so LAF preference overrides cannot leak between rows.

bounds.enforcement: declared; static-only; future runner must enforce

future_oracle_actions: Expand matrix.json#/target_lanes into twelve independent rows: Linux x86_64/aarch64, Windows x86_64/aarch64, and macOS x86_64/aarch64 each crossed with Java 8 and Java 17. Provision the pinned JMeter/JVM on each declared OS image, clear its fresh lane-specific preference root, set JMETER_LANGUAGE and java.util.prefs.userRoot before startup, activate the lane's ProcessTree supervisor gate, verify the worker/JMeter/classpath/plugin identities, and start a real display-backed GUI with that row's environment and properties.

Record effective language, Swing LAF selection using exact os.name then os-family lookup, toolbar/icon resource and size, tree icon size, HiDPI settings, expand-tree state, global undo capacity, and text-area undo capacity per lane.
Restart after each LAF change, reopen the lane's copied plan, and compare only that lane's normalized settings fields; retain raw UI/property diagnostics outside Git.
Run the declared headless argv only as a no-display persistence/parser probe; it must not be used to claim LAF, toolbar, icon, HiDPI, tree, or undo rendering.
Mark a row unavailable when its OS/display/runtime boundary cannot be provisioned; do not treat headless startup or a missing display as GUI evidence.
limitations: The property values and matrix are original planned inputs; no locale, LAF, toolbar, tree, HiDPI, expand-tree, or undo setting was observed.
Linux, Windows, and macOS rows are explicit planned matrix entries, not platform compatibility claims.
A GUI display server and OS facilities are required external capabilities for future evidence.
The matrix's twelve target/Java rows and OS-name candidates are bounded future lanes; they are not evidence that any runner, supervisor, JVM, or display is available.
The language property is intentionally absent from this -q file; locale must be established by launcher/JVM settings before JMeterUtils.initLocale.
